SAMPluginCommonMetadata.description: Smarter API Plugin Manifest - common Metadata class.

annotations.description: Annotations, as in Kubernetes: a map of keys to string values that clients and integrations attach to a resource for their own purposes, e.g. to associate it with a resource in another system. A key is an optional DNS-subdomain prefix that names its owner, then a slash and a name of one or more slash-separated segments, e.g. 'acme.com/crm-account-id'. The prefix 'smarter.sh' and its subdomains are reserved for the Smarter platform. Values are strings: unquoted YAML scalars such as true, 42 or dates are converted to strings, and structured data belongs in a JSON string. All annotations together are limited to 256 KiB. The list of one-key maps of older manifests, e.g. [{'acme.com/crm-account-id': 'A-10042'}], is also accepted.
annotations.title: Annotations

maxTokens.title: Maxtokens

model.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.model[str] Optional. The model of the Plugin. Defaults to gpt-6-luna. Must be one of: ['chat-latest', 'gpt-4.1', 'gpt-4.1-2025-04-14', 'gpt-4.1-mini', 'gpt-4.1-mini-2025-04-14', 'gpt-4o', 'gpt-4o-2024-08-06', 'gpt-4o-2024-11-20', 'gpt-4o-mini', 'gpt-4o-mini-2024-07-18', 'gpt-5-search-api', 'gpt-5-search-api-2025-10-14', 'gpt-5.2', 'gpt-5.2-2025-12-11', 'gpt-5.4', 'gpt-5.4-2026-03-05', 'gpt-5.4-mini', 'gpt-5.4-mini-2026-03-17', 'gpt-5.5', 'gpt-5.5-2026-04-23', 'gpt-5.6-luna', 'gpt-5.6-sol', 'gpt-5.6-terra', 'gpt-6-astra', 'gpt-6-luna', 'gpt-6-sol', 'gpt-6.1-sol']

provider.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.provider[str]. Optional. The provider of the LLM. Defaults to openai. The provider is the vendor name for the LLM service that will be used to generate the prompt response.
provider.title: Provider

systemRole.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.systemRole[str]. Required. The system role that the Plugin will use for the LLM text completion prompt. Be verbose and specific. Ensure that systemRole accurately conveys to the LLM how you want it to use the Plugin data that is returned. The maximum length is 32768 characters.
systemRole.title: Systemrole

temperature.description: Plugin.spec.prompt.temperature[float] Optional. The temperature of the Plugin. Defaults to 1.0. Should be between 0 and 1.0. The higher the temperature, the more creative the response. The lower the temperature, the more predictable the response.
temperature.title: Temperature
